description: Updates one Action Plan Item. Title, description, and holding type can be changed only when the parent Action Plan is in draft. Due date, notes, and status can be updated while the plan is in progress if the user has permission.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Selects the shape of the returned item, matching the same view on Show Action Plan Item. `normal` (default) returns the full item; `extended` adds the parent plan and plan section; `flat_v0` return...

data.description: Action Plan Item. Field-for-field identical to the v1.0 Action Plan Item, except that every id / *_id attribute (at any nesting depth, including inside plan_item_assignees) is a string, per the Res...

id.description: Unique identifier for this Action Plan Item.

created_at.description: Timestamp in ISO 8601 format when this item was created.

description.description: Detailed description of the work or inspection required for this Action Plan Item.

due_at.description: Due date for this item in ISO 8601 format. Null if no due date has been set.

holding_type.description: Action Plan Item holding type specifies whether the current item holds all the succeeding items in the section or the plan

is_blocked.description: Indicates whether current Action Plan Item is blocked by another Action Plan Item

is_blocking.description: Indicates whether current Action Plan Item is blocking other Action Plan Items

notes.description: Free-text notes attached to this Action Plan Item.

plan_id.description: ID of the Action Plan this item belongs to.

position.description: Ordinal position of this item within its section.

plan_section_id.description: ID of the section this item belongs to within the Action Plan.

title.description: Short title summarizing the inspection or task for this Action Plan Item.

id.description: Unique identifier for the item status. Reflects the item's real status, including any company-custom status — unlike the v1.0 list endpoint, which downgrades company-custom statuses to the built-in...

name.description: Display name of the status (e.g. 'In Progress', or a company-custom name such as 'Ready for Testing').

status.description: Underlying status type category this status maps to. Custom company statuses map to one of these built-in keys.

global.description: Whether this is a built-in Procore status available to every company.

template_item_id.description: ID of the plan template item this item was generated from. Null if the item was created directly rather than from a template.

updated_at.description: Timestamp in ISO 8601 format when this item was last updated.

404.description: Not Found. Action Plan Item does not exist.

409.description: Conflict. The parent Action Plan is not in a modifiable state.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity. Validation failed for the provided attributes.

title.description: Short title summarizing the inspection or task for this Action Plan Item.

description.description: Detailed description of the work or inspection required for this Action Plan Item.

due_at.description: Due date for this item in ISO 8601 format.

holding_type.description: Whether the item holds all succeeding items in the section or in the plan.

notes.description: Free text notes attached to this Action Plan Item.

status_id.description: ID of the item status to set. May be a built in status or a company custom status.
